description: This Python module provides database maintenance utilities for a sports telecast backend project. It includes functions to inspect PostgreSQL advisory locks, terminate sessions holding specific locks, reset and reapply database migrations using Alembic, and handle related database tasks.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _get_lock_key_pair(key: int)
methods.description: Converts a bigint advisory lock key into two 32-bit integers (classid, objid) for PostgreSQL advisory lock handling.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] inspect_locks(engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Inspects and summarizes current advisory locks and blocked sessions in the PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] clear_advisory_lock_holders(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Terminates sessions holding or waiting on a specified advisory lock key.

methods.name: Config _alembic_config()
methods.description: Creates and configures an Alembic Config object pointing to the project's migration directory.

methods.name: None alembic_reset()
methods.description: Resets the Alembic version table by truncating it, if it exists.

methods.name: None alembic_stamp_base()
methods.description: Stamps the database at the initial 'base' migration without applying any migrations.

methods.name: None alembic_upgrade(revision: str = "head")
methods.description: Runs an Alembic upgrade to the given revision, defaulting to 'head'.

ctags.name: clear_advisory_lock_holders
ctags.pattern: /^def clear_advisory_lock_holders(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine) ->/

ctags.name: sync_engine
ctags.pattern: /^from .connection import engine as sync_engine  # uses sync engine for admin ops$/
